title: InferSwarm Phase-0 workload manifest
description: Frozen workload set for a Phase-0 baseline campaign. Criteria section 9 fixes the four classes; InferSwarm issue #3 supplies the realistic W1/W3/W4 fixtures. The authoritative validator is benchmarks/inferswarm_phase0/manifest.py, which enforces rules this schema cannot express (content hash equality, canonical output-token counts, the seed prohibition).

canonical.description: true only for a manifest frozen for a real Phase-0 campaign. A canonical run refuses a manifest that does not declare this.

frozen_at.description: ISO-8601 date/time the set was frozen

provenance.description: Where the fixtures came from (dataset, transcript, issue #3 artifact ids).

class_id.description: W1 coding/agentic (<=2000 prompt, 512 out); W2 open-ended reasoning (<=1000, 512); W3 long context (~16000, 256); W4 short interactive (~128, 128).

fixture_path.description: UTF-8 prompt file, relative to the manifest. Mutually exclusive with 'content'.

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact UTF-8 prompt bytes. Validation fails on mismatch: re-freeze deliberately rather than updating the hash to match a changed prompt.

output_tokens.description: Exact generated-token count (with ignore_eos). Canonical values are fixed per class by criteria section 9.

ignore_eos.description: Canonical runs require true so output length is exact and identical across arms (criteria section 3 rule 5).

sampling.description: Every field stated explicitly; the server's own defaults must never fill one in. temperature<=0 (or top_k==1) with top_p==1 is greedy, mirroring SamplingParams.is_greedy.

seed.description: Must be null. FreeToken's SamplingParams (python/freetoken/core.py) exposes no seed parameter anywhere; a non-null value is rejected rather than silently ignored. Reproducibility comes from greedy decoding (criteria section 5.3).

chat_template_kwargs.description: Passed through to the server's chat template, e.g. {"enable_thinking": true}.
